0022600096.text: The Timberwolves (1-0, 1-0 on the road, 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West) visit the Orlando Magic (0-1, 0-1 at home, 4th in the Southeast and 11th in the East), with Minnesota on a W1 streak and Orlando on an L1 streak. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (out, hamstring), and Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. There are no games yet between the teams in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Timberwolves lost 0-2, including a 132-120 loss in Orlando in their most recent regular-season meeting on 2026-04-08.
